lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters organized into vertical columns, forming a regular geometric grid across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running across the lateral flank, each exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.
